scope: User-selected official CAD Assistant independently imports three exact SAB payloads associated with one public AC1027 source; compare the solid's displayed properties and topology to the separately implemented cq-acis parser/converter. This is not a second independent geometry kernel, source-native oracle, complete 3D consumer test or support claim.

reader.application: Official CAD Assistant 1.6.0 macOS ARM64, read-only mounted bundle; macOS 27.0.1 build 26A434
reader.integrity: Earlier native mount passed strict deep code signature and Gatekeeper notarization assessment, documented in p7-cad-assistant-arm64-integrity-preflight-2026-11-01.json.
reader.procedure: Open each explicitly named extracted .sab from /private/tmp/p7-ac1027-semantic in CAD Assistant, select the loaded document, inspect its Actual properties, Location and Stats panels. The solid was initially hidden by the application's file browser; an explicit reopen produced a visible model and populated properties. A separate unrelated system authentication dialog was not touched. Screenshots are cropped to the application's properties panel and remain scratch-only.

association.method: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 produced ACAD2013 DXF with audit=0, exit 0, empty stdout/stderr and no .err. tests/ac1027_acds_source_compare.py rejoined the hashed DWG, source probe, physical AcDs records, model-space entity frames and exact ODA group-310 payloads for all three handles. This independently binds carrier bytes and source entities; the source probe reports three object parse failures and one orphan DataStorage record.

limits: CAD Assistant's Validation properties None is not a validity result. Displayed measurements are rounded and may follow import repair; native producer values, placed DWG bounds/units, and before-repair state remain unknown. CAD Assistant and cq-acis use separate ACIS decoding paths but share the OCCT kernel family. cq-acis retained raw asmheader and solid-history attribute records whose geometry/placement effects are unproven. The two REGION numeric observations have no independent semantic oracle. No DWG/DXF/SAB fixture, application binary or screenshot is committed; this does not qualify general P7 support, native FreeCAD, platforms or independent-kernel semantics.
